reasoning: This is the standard icon for a Git branch or version control fork (a vertical line with a diverging curved path and three commit nodes). It is an unmistakable and top-choice visual cue for software development tasks involving branching, merging, rebasing, and repositories, as well as branching logic or genealogy, though it is domain-specific and can trap literal 'tree branch' or 'bank branch' tasks via shared vocabulary.
